method: Three ordinary pictures inspected,standard PMTiles/global Terrarium only.

references.name: aerial
references.observed: Aerial actually inspected: pink-and-white diamond-inlaid upper western range, two open stacked arcades below, large pointed upper windows and projecting center balcony. Pale gray sheet-metal hips with Gothic pinnacles,open principal court and taller pale Renaissance canal range. Northern attached buildings meet the independent basilica;do not substitute a plain isolated rectangular shell.

references.name: courtyard
references.observed: Courtyard stair actually inspected: broad straight supported marble stair to the upper gallery,solid side balustrades,pedestals with two original simplified figures,round ground arches and pointed upper arches. Three upper openings behind landing andclosed rear gallery wall;no invented black doorway painted on a blank wall.

references.name: canal
references.observed: Lagoon/canal actually inspected: two true open arcade levels along the lagoon andwest front;stone diamond inlays over them,large pointed glazed windows,central balcony andthin pinnacle silhouette. The east side has red brick andpale surrounds adjoining a taller white Renaissance range;Bridge of Sighs andPonte della Paglia are independent context.
